instruction: Use ug-filesystem find to locate the file with pattern "Rosa timesheet Nov 2-8.pdf" (or a close match under a Nanny folder). Return its full path and modification date.

Use ug-document extract on the file "Nanny/Rosa timesheet Nov 2-8.pdf". Extract every row of the timesheet for Nov 2-8 2026: date, shift start, shift end, hours or amount billed, and any hourly rate printed on the bill. Return the rows and the printed hourly rate.

Authorization: the household has confirmed that Rosa Delgado knows the front door camera recognises faces and that it may be used to check her working hours. Step 1: list the cameras and confirm the front door camera recognises faces. Step 2: check that Rosa Delgado is a registered known face (ug-surveillance faces, identity-type known). Step 3: run ug-surveillance event-timeline for the front door camera, start-time 2026-11-02 00:00, end-time 2026-11-09 00:00, timezone America/New_York, topic HumanFace, identity-type known, person-name Rosa Delgado, limit 200. Return every event with date, time and camera, and the first and last event per day.

Authorization (already confirmed by the household): Rosa Delgado knows the front door camera recognises faces and it may be used to check her working hours. Please run ug-surveillance event-timeline now and return the actual event list, not only a match result. Parameters: camera-id = front door camera (look up its id from the cameras list first), start-time 2026-11-02 00:00, end-time 2026-11-09 00:00, timezone America/New_York, topic HumanFace, identity-type known, person-name Rosa Delgado, limit 200. Return every event with date, time (local New York), and camera; and also state whether the front door camera recognises faces.
